entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane of varied environments, focused on land and exploration.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: A continent of Zendikar with perpendicular cliffs, treasure-laden interior and wild mana, ringed by treacherous waters.

entities.name: Kazuul
entities.description: An ogre slavemaster and self-styled businessman, Tyrant of the Cliffs, who commands warrior-slaves and demands tribute from those scaling Murasa's cliffs.

entities.name: Kazuul's Warrior-Slaves
entities.description: Kazuul's chained slaves and ogre brutes who attack expeditions that refuse to pay.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker who subsists for millennia as a vampire feeding on lifeblood.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who took a contract with demons for eternal youth and power.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An old planeswalker with a cross-planar arsenal of life-extending spells, worse for wear since the Mending.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: The event that made planeswalkers mortal.

entities.name: Demons
entities.description: Beings with whom Liliana made her contract.

events.summary: Kazuul demands tribute from anyone attempting to ascend the cliffs of Murasa.
events.quote: All he asks—all he asks!—is a tribute.

events.summary: Kazuul commands a small army of warrior-slaves.
events.quote: He commands a small army of warrior-slaves.

events.summary: Kazuul's warrior-slaves attack those who refuse his tribute, and travelers become his slaves.
events.quote: Where do you think Kazuul gets his slaves?

events.summary: Liliana makes a contract with demons to gain eternal youth and power.
events.quote: Liliana, for her part, took a daring but straightforward route to eternal youth and power: a contract with demons.

events.summary: The Mending makes planeswalkers mortal, wearing down Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: since the Mending made planeswalkers mortal

relations.note: Murasa is a continent of Zendikar.

relations.quote: He commands a small army of warrior-slaves.

relations.note: Kazuul reigns over the pass on Murasa's cliffs.
relations.quote: he, Kazuul, Tyrant of the Cliffs, reigns over the pass

relations.note: Liliana has a contract with demons.
